description: Fixture-library contract for photo-wall scanner and integration tests. The scanner work in a later phase will materialize the photos described here.

library-smoke.purpose: Happy-path library used for default integration tests and the docker-compose mount fallback.
notes: Populated by phase2-task2 (scanner). Placeholder folder exists today so the bind mount works.
Shape will follow year/event nesting: e.g. 2024/wedding-anna/IMG_0001.jpg.

library-edge.purpose: Edge-case library used by hardening tests.
notes: Will exercise symlink skipping, unsupported file types, corrupt images, missing year prefixes, and deeply nested paths.
Populated incrementally as scanner edge-case requirements come online.
